headline:
You don't have a traffic problem.
You have a session economics problem.
intro: Most ecommerce brands pour budget into paid traffic while ignoring the silent conversion killers on their own store — Cut, or cite a source you can defend.

problems.title: You're paying for sessions that don't pay you back. Every visitor you buy has a cost
problems.description: your store can't convert them profitably, more ad spend just scales the loss.

problems.title: Your funnel has hidden drop-off points
problems.description: Most brands don't know where exactly they're losing customers — product page? Cart? Checkout? A funnel audit reveals the exact points bleeding your revenue.

problems.title: Your copy doesn't close the sale
problems.description: Weak headlines, unclear value props, and misaligned CTAs silently kill conversions. A copy audit rewrites the moments that matter most to your buyer journey.

problems.title: You're guessing instead of testing. Changes shipped on gut feel can quietly cost you revenue
problems.description: and you'd never know which ones did.
